**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include the required final-review template or use the vendored reviewer**

For agents executing the vendored skills, the final review now requires `../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md`, but that template is not included. A repo-wide search, including hidden files, found neither this template nor a `requesting-code-review` skill; the existing companion is `skills/requesting-review/SKILL.md`. `executing-plans` introduces the same missing dependency, including requiring agents without subagent tools to read the template. Bundle the required companion or adapt both execution skills to the reviewer procedure already present so the final-review gate remains executable from this checkout.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve the project directory before changing directories**

When invoked from a project with `--project-dir .` or another relative path, the launcher creates the session directories relative to the caller, then changes into `SCRIPT_DIR` before using those same relative paths for the PID, log, and server environment. In foreground mode, this produces a `server.pid: No such file or directory` error and directs Node to a different session tree; background mode cannot open the intended log file. Normalize `PROJECT_DIR` to an absolute path before deriving the session and persistence paths so relative project arguments work consistently.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Persist selections sent through the explicit choice API**

When a mockup calls the exposed `brainstorm.choice('layout-a')` API, this helper sends `{type: 'choice', value: 'layout-a'}`, but `server.cjs` only appends events to `state_dir/events` when `event.choice` is truthy. Consequently, these selections appear in server logs but never reach the events file that the visual-companion workflow instructs the agent to read. I reproduced this against the server: an API choice created no events file, while a normal click event was persisted. Emit the expected `choice` field or update the server to persist the explicit API's payload.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

Fixed in `3cbbb71`: `skills/requesting-code-review/SKILL.md` and `code-reviewer.md` are now vendored byte-exact from the live skill source (skill.yaml excluded per the sync contract), so the final-review gate in subagent-driven-development and executing-plans resolves from a repo checkout. Verified by an independent reviewer: byte-exactness, reference closure, and docs-lint green on the final head.

Fixed in `f9195dc`: `PROJECT_DIR` is now created if needed and canonicalized to an absolute path in the live `start-server.sh` before `SESSION_DIR`/port/token paths are derived (repo copy mirrored byte-exact). Verified functionally: the pre-fix script reproduced this failure verbatim with a relative project dir; the fixed script exits 0 with the session tree under the intended dir (relative, nonexistent, `.`, absolute, and no-dir cases all exercised by an independent reviewer). ShellCheck clean; shell-lint green.

Fixed in `19e040e`: the explicit API now emits `{type: 'choice', choice: value, value, ...metadata}` in the live `helper.js` (repo copy mirrored byte-exact), so explicit-API selections satisfy the server's persistence gate exactly like clicks. Verified against the real server over WebSocket by the implementer and independently re-verified by a second reviewer: old shape persisted nothing, new shape persisted exactly one correct entry, clicks unchanged. Note: Codex's re-review of this head has been stuck in 'running' for ~30 min; the repo owner directed merging on CI + the two independent reviews.
